name: tesla_garden
theme: an empty Victorian electrical laboratory at night — its plasma discharge branches out into a magnetar's field-line cage, then down through aurora to the laboratory's own glass dome

registers.name: laboratory
registers.scene: a wide Victorian electrical laboratory at night seen from the doorway at floor level, long mahogany benches ranked down the room under a high ribbed-glass ceiling dome, brass coils and glass instruments crowded on the shelves, violet light across the dark wood and the black and white tiled floor, empty, no one present, a small glass globe alight with violet on a bench across the room
registers.target: a round glass globe alight with violet
registers.loop_target: the wide Victorian electrical laboratory at night, mahogany benches and brass coils under the ribbed-glass dome, violet light on dark wood

registers.name: plasma_globe
registers.scene: the inside of a glass plasma globe, a deep violet chamber walled in curved glass, a black electrode column at its center, ragged threads of electric blue rooted along the column
registers.target: a bright arc filament, a jagged rope of electric blue and white

registers.name: arc_filament
registers.scene: a single arc filament fills the black, a jagged rope of white-hot light in a violet haze, fine hairs of discharge standing out along its length
registers.target: a forked fan of fine white and violet threads

registers.name: lichtenberg
registers.scene: a Lichtenberg tree of electrical discharge on black, forked white and violet branches dividing into ever finer filaments, a fractal of bare light

registers.name: magnetar_cage
registers.scene: a magnetar held in a cage of its own magnetic field, huge violet field-line arcs looped pole to pole around a hard white star, an indigo starfield beyond
registers.target: a hard white star, a searing sphere with twin pale beams at its poles

registers.name: pulsar_beams
registers.scene: twin pulsar beams stand from a white neutron star, two long cones of pale blue light across the dark, copper-toned dust aglow along their length
registers.target: a copper-toned metal planet, burnished and banded with dark ore

registers.name: copper_planet
registers.scene: a copper-toned metal planet fills the view, burnished plains and dark ore ridges wrapped across its curve, tall violet aurora curtains over its pole, black space at its limb
registers.target: a tall aurora curtain, a pleated wall of violet and green light

registers.name: aurora
registers.palette: violet and green glow on black
registers.scene: within a pleated aurora curtain high over a dark copper plain, walls of violet and green light standing on either side, the ore-dark ground below
registers.target: a ribbed glass dome, heavy brass ribs framing tall lit panes

registers.name: observatory_dome
registers.scene: a ribbed glass observatory dome on the dark copper plain, heavy brass ribs framing tall panes lit violet from beneath, a low brick laboratory building at its base, the violet aurora sky above

music_theme: a hushed Victorian electrical laboratory charged into a cosmic storm — dark synth drone, glassy bell tones and static-crackle texture, a hard electric hit landing on the discharge-to-magnetar seam
